properties.content:
Report Details

Nearest City: WA
Location: LAT 47 40.46 N
Location2: OFF SKIFPOINT, JUST EAST OF BAINBRIDGE ISLAND
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: WASHINGTON STATE FERRIES
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 47.674444, -122.475556 (Explicit)
Report DescriptionTHIS IS A POTENTIAL RELEASE... INFORMATION RECEIVED FROM THE NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER AND USCG SECTOR PUGET SOUND... AT APPROXIMATELY 2000Z (1400 PST), WASHINGTON STATE FERRY WENATCHEE EXPERIENCED A FIRE IN THE NUMBER TWO ENGINE ROOM AFTER A CRANK CASE EXPLOSION WHILE CONDUCTING POWER TRIALS IN PUGET SOUND. THERE WERE NO PASSENGERS ON BOARD, ONLY 13 CREWMEMBERS. FERRY WENATCHEE WAS TOWED BY TUG TO EAGLE HARBOR IN BAINBRIDGE ISLAND. THE CREW AND LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT SUCCESSFULLY EXTINGUISHED FIRE. THE DAMAGE TO THE FERRY WENATCHEE IS VALUED TO BE IN EXCESS OF $500,000. THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR POLLUTION REPORTED. COAST GUARD RESPONDED WITH THREE SMALL BOATS, AND ONE COAST GUARD HELICOPTER. SECTOR PUGET SOUND INVESTIGATOR AND INSPECTOR RESPONDING. NO MEDIA ATTENTION AT THIS TIME. USCG CONFIRMED THERE WAS NO MATERIAL RELEASED FROM THIS INCIDENT. USCG STATED THERE WAS A POTENTIAL RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN OIL AND DIESEL FUEL FROM THIS INCIDENT.

A VIDEO OF THE GARBAGE DISPOSAL INCIDENT, OBTAINED DURING THE PSC INSPECTION, INDICATES THAT THE GARBAGE, CONTAINED IN A BLACK PLASTIC GARBAGE BAG, PURPORTEDLY CONSISTED OF FOOD WASTE, IN ADDITION TO PLASTIC BOTTLES, OILY RAGS AND HOSES. AT THE TIME OF THE DISPOSAL, THE VESSEL WAS ENROUTE TO THE CERTAIN TEED TERMINAL IN BUCHANAN, NY WITH AN ETA OF THE SAME DAY, I,E SEPTEMBER 13, 2023. AN EXAMINATION OF THE VESSEL’S GARBAGE RECORD BOOK DOES NOT INDICATE ANY ENTRIES BEING MADE ON SEPTEMBER 13, 2023 RELATING TO THAT DISPOSAL.
